usage: The word '叔叔' refers specifically to the father's younger brother in the family context.
'叔叔' is used as a noun to identify a male relative and can also be a polite way to address an unrelated older man.
When speaking about family members, use '叔叔' to distinguish from '伯伯', which means father's older brother.
'叔叔' can be used directly before a name or alone to refer to the uncle, e.g., '我叔叔。'
It is common to use '叔叔' in everyday conversations when discussing family or addressing the person politely.
